description: This file defines a SwiftUI ViewModifier called StatusGlassCardModifier and an extension on View to apply this modifier, for styling UI elements as semi-transparent, glass-like cards with configurable padding and contrast adjustments.

classes.name: StatusGlassCardModifier
classes.description: A ViewModifier that applies a stylish glass-like background with configurable contrast and padding.

methods.name: statusGlassCard
methods.description: An extension method on View that applies the StatusGlassCardModifier with specified styling parameters.
